content: Wapongte Yowadi ngic fikewec
Esecne fungina molickelu, monic wacine Yowadi gawec. Nga Yowa ye Wapongkolec gawec. Ailu Yowa yeuctihac Wapong.
Ailu ye hocne esecne fungina molickelu Wapongkolec gawec.
Aime Wapongti mime Yowadi wiyac sasawa kwefickeyackewec. Wiyac sasawa fikelu fayackegac, yogo yengungtihac monic mi fikeibong.
Yowa yela hocne gaga fawec. Aime gaga yogodi ngic-ngigac yengele Angoc ailu Wapongte yefe noine edalicebawec.
Aime Angocti kundung kweme angoleme, kundungti Angoc yogo someckenale aibibiyelu hegilewec.
Yesu ye Gaga nga Angocte fungine
Wapongti ngic monic saleme kwesiwec, yele wacine Yoane.
Yedi Angoc yogolec mime yegengkeme, Angoc yogodi ngic-ngigac bacebame angoleningte kwesiwec. Ye kwesilu ngic-ngigac sasawadi Angoc yogo ngagesingkeningte miwec.
Ye yeicnebac Angoc yogo miyac. Yebac Angoc yogo mime yegengkenale kwesiwec.
Aime Angoc yogo noinebenang, ye himongka kwesilu ngic-ngigac sasawa bacebame angolecaigaing.
Wapong ye Angocti himong nga wiyac sasawa bayackeme, Angoc yogodi himongka game ngic-ngigac yenge ye mi ngani-motoibong.
Ye yeicne alingfocine yengela kwesime yengi mac mi holecnoibong.
Aimebac ngic-ngigac mac holecnolu wacine ngagesingkeibong, yenge nalic Wapong adu-madecfocine ainingte miwec.
Yele adu-madec yogo yenge ngic sackacni, me socte angackacni me ngic monicte angackacni monic mi fikeibong, miyac. Yenge Wapong yeuctihac mime fikeibong.

Aime Yowadi ngic soc-biuckolec ailu hewacnonggang gawec. Madec moniyang yedi hocne galu Mamactacni wac feicne balu gawec, wac feicne yogo hocne nganiibeng. Yogo kwele-madicte wiyac nga yowa noine wakeyackeicne fagac.
Yoane ye Yesule yefe baba
Yoanedi yele fungine mime yegengkeme wackelu yanguc miwec, “Na yele hocne yanguc edocngebaiba, ‘Ngic lobena kwesilu gagac, ye na mi fikeebewa yedi biyachac gawecte na ewalicnugac.’ ”
Yefe-yowadi Mosesla kwesime baibeng. Nga kwele-madic ailu yowa noine yogobac Yesu Kristoholec kwesiwec. Ailu ye kwele-madic bucbuchac facnogac, yogodi nongilang moto-motoine mikac kwesinolecaigac.
Monicti Wapong monic mi nganiwec, miyac. Madecine moniyang sugudi Mamacine emeina wetackelu gacaigac, ye Wapong. Yedi Mamacte fungine mime yegengkenolewec.
Yoane boleinele fungine
Yuda ngic Yerusalem taonka gaibong, yengi depec-baba ngic nga Liwai aling gocne salecebabong Yoanela hikelu yanguc uwacnoibong, “Ga ma ngic?”
Uwacnobong, ye yeicne fungineine mi hesongkeyelewec. Ye edocebalu yanguc mime yegengkewec, “Na Mesia miyac.” Yoane ye inguc mime yegengkewec.

Inguc mime yengi hatacmac uwacnoibong, “Aime Elaiya hatac kwesidaicte, ga ye, me?” Uwacnobong yedi miwec, “Na ye miyac.” Mime miibong, “Aime Wapongte siduc-mimi ngicbenang kwesinale miicne, ga ye, me?” Mibong “miyac” miwec.
Inguc mime yanguc miibong, “Aime ga maa? Nonge ngic salecnubagaing, yengela yowa ameine wenuc bahikelu edocebadabelengte? Gageicnele wenuc migic?”
Inguc mibong Yoanedi yanguc edocebawec,

content.text: “Himong kisiwa misaine mikacka yowa-malac monic fikegac, yogo nani hocne yanguc wackegabac, ‘Ngenge Sugucnele yefe hole-wenengkening.’ (Yes 40:3)

content: Siduc-mimi ngic Yesaiyadi nale inguc miwec.”
Aime ngic hikeibong yengele alingkacni Farisaio gocne yengi
Yoane yanguc uwacnoibong, “Ga Mesia miyac, nga Elaiya miyac, ailu Wapongte siduc-mimi ngic miyac. Aime ga omale ngic-ngigac misa lowayelecaigic?”
Inguc mibong Yoanedi bafaliyelu yanguc edocebawec, “Na misa lowangelecaigabac. Aimebac Yuda ngic-ngigac ngengele hewacka ngic monic gagac, ngenge ye mi ngagegaing.
Ye nale lobewa kwesilu gagac, ye feicne aigacte na waweweine ingucnedi yele hige-ebecte mucine lukebe nalic mi madickedaicte.”
Yoane ye Betani macka Yodan misa nebocina misa lowayelelu gawec, iwa wiyac yogo fikewec.
Yesule fungine
Mac saeme Yoane ye domame Yesudi yela weleme nganilu ngic-ngigac yanguc edocebawec, “Nganining, yogo Wapongte lama madecine
, ye himongtowa yagolec ngic-ngigac sasawa yengele bikic baickedaicte.
Yele hocne ngagelu yanguc miiba, ‘Ngic monic lobena kwesilu gagac, ye na mi fikeebewa yedi biyachac gawecte na ewalicnugac.
Na ye mi ngage-motoiba. Aime Israel ngic-ngigac ngenge yedi yegengkenale na kwesilu misa lowangeleiba.’ ”
Yoanedi yanguc mime yegengkewec, “Na Tili Asu nganibe, ye tudiling nangole silic ingucne honocmengkacni walu yele feiwa ngiyewec, yogo nganiiba.
Aime na ye mi ngage-motoebewa Wapongti salecnuwec, ye misa lowangelebele, ailu yanguc edocnuwec, ‘Asudi walu ngic yela ngiyeme nganidamecte, yedibac Tili Asudi lowangeledaicte.’
Na yogo hocne nganilu yanguc biyachac mibe yegengkewec, ngic yedi Wapongte Madec.”
Yesu mic-tengtengfocine
Aime mac saeme, Yoane ye mic-tengtengfocine yengelacni mic-tengteng yaeckang yekeholec mac iwa hatacmac domaibong.
Domaebongka Yesu hikeme nganilu mic-tengtengkecine yanguc edocepawec, “Nganinic, yogo Wapongte lama madecine.”
Inguc mime ngagelu mic-tengtengkecine yeke Yesu balaibelu hikeiboc.
Hikeboc Yesudi hefaliye nganicepalu yanguc uwayetewec,
Inguc uwayeteme miiboc, “Rabai,” (yogolec fungine wewedu bafaliyeicne) “ga mac wenuwa gagic?”
Inguc miboc yanguc edocepawec,
Inguc mime yenge momoc hikelu mac gawec yogo nganiiboc. Aime hadeng iwa dameng 4 kilok biyac aiwecte ailu yeholec ngiyeiboc.
Aime Yoanele yowa ngagelu Yesu balaibeiboc, yekelacni monic Endru, ye Saimon Pita gbaine.
Yedi Yesu nganilu hatacmac molickelu hefaliye hikelu haeine Saimon bafuwalu yanguc edowec, “Noke Mesia bafuwagabelec.” (Mesia yogolec fungine Kristo bafaliyeicne.)
Inguc milu Saimon mengockeme Yesula hikeboc, Yesudi ye nganilu yanguc miwec,

content.text: “Ga Saimon Yoane monicte madec, yogo noine. Aimebac gale wacgone gbolicne Kefas minoga.”

content: (Yogolec fungine posa, nga Grik yowawa Pita.)
Mac saeme Yesu ye Galili prowinswa hikenogale ngagelu hikelu, ngic monic wacine Filip, ye bafuwalu yanguc edowec,
Filip nga Endru ailu Pita yenge Besaida taonkacni.

Aime Filip ye ngic monic wacine Natanael, ye bafuwalu yanguc edowec, “Mosesdi yefe-yowale hibiwa kwelengkewec, nga siduc-mimi ngic yengi inguchac kwelengkeibong, nonge ngic yogo bafuwagabeleng. Yogo Yesu hocne, Yosefele madec, Nasaret taonkacni.”
Inguc mime Natanaeldi yanguc miwec, “Nasaret mac yogo mac omane. Aime mac iwa wiyac madicne monic nalic fikedaicte, me?” Inguc mime Filipdi miwec, “Ga welelu nganic.” Mime hikeiboc.
Hikeboc Yesudi Natanael nganime yela leme yanguc miwec,

content.text: “Nganining, ngic yago Israel ngic noine, yela lokwesac nga kwesac-aibaba monic mi fagac.”

content: Inguc mime Natanaeldi yanguc uwacnowec, “Ga yefe wenucka ngagecnugic?” Inguc mime Yesudi yanguc edowec,

content.text: “Filip ye ga mi wacgume welegabiyec, dameng iwa fik yoc fungina ga geicnac ngiyeengka biyac nganicgugabac.”

content: Inguc mime Natanaeldi yanguc edowec, “Wewedu, ga Wapongte Madec, Israel nongele Ngictau.”
Inguc mime Yesudi bafaliyelu yanguc edowec,

content.text: “Ga fik yoc fungina ngiyeengka nganicgubac inguc edocgugabacte ngagesingnugic, me? Gacgu pasi yangucne hatacmac ewalilu sugucnehac fikeme nganidamecte.
Foinac, honocmeng angkeme Ngicte Madec ye honocmengte liti ingucne aime, Wapongte angelofocine yela edelu fec-wac aibong nganicebadaingte, yogo noinebenang edocngebagabac.”

footnotes.text: Betani yogo mac yaeckang yekele wac. Monic Yerusalem emeina, nga monic Yodan emeina inguc faiboc.
Israel ngic-ngigac yenge bikicngineng miyac ainale lama madecine depec lobelu gaibong.
